ops.text: Claude Code CLI 2026-10-02: in /Users/yasyf/.orca/workspaces/cc-remote/fresh-startup-92s, `claude plugin update codex@skills --scope project --json` reported `up_to_date` with oldVersion 1.14.9, even though installed_plugins.json pinned the project-scope entry at 1.14.8. It appears to compare against the user-scope entry. `claude plugin install codex@skills --scope project` then said "installed 1.14.8, available 1.14.9, run update --scope project", so the two commands loop. Workaround: an atomic hand edit of only that project entry to the cached 1.14.9 installPath/sha, with a before-snapshot at setup-20261001/installed_plugins.before-pin-update.json.
